rationale: `assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with `---\nname: ...\n---` front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`. The requirement has one MUST: the description must state when to use the skill in terms of the user's task. The description opens with "Use when adopting Habeas in an existing codebase, when the user asks for a requirements coverage audit." Both triggers are user tasks. The rest of the description says what the skill does. It ends with "For missing test references or stale evidence, use habeas-evidence." That names another bundled skill the agent could confuse with this one, which the requirement allows with MAY and which imposes nothing to check. No violation matches were listed for this site, and I found no gap.
